description: Adds automatically generated subtitles to a supplied video segment using a subtitle preset or custom text styling. Starts a background job that costs credits; returns a project id for wait_for_video_project. Before choosing settings, read get_account_info and the current parameter constraints. A listed model, resolution, duration or count is not necessarily available together or on this account. Preserve explicit requirements and all supplied inputs; explain a genuine block instead of submitting an incompatible request. Account balance alone does not prove a request is affordable. Use the named attachment fields first for ChatGPT files. Ask which file goes where if their roles are unclear. If a file fails, ask the user to attach it again and keep the requested settings.

Idempotency-Key.description: A unique string for this request, such as a UUID. Sending the same key again within 24 hours returns the original project instead of creating and charging for a new one. A key applies across all video, image, and audio endpoints on your account, so use a new key for every project.

assets.description: Provide the assets for auto subtitle generator

video_file_path.description:
This is the video used to add subtitles. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

end_seconds.description: End time of your clip (seconds). Must be greater than start_seconds.

name.description: Optional project name for identifying this output. Omit to use the API's default project name.

start_seconds.description: Start time of your clip (seconds). Must be ≥ 0.

style.description:
Style of the subtitle. At least one of `.style.template` or `.style.custom_config` must be provided. 
* If only `.style.template` is provided, default values for the template will be used.
* If both are provided, the fields in `.style.custom_config` will be used to overwrite the fields in `.style.template`.
* If only `.style.custom_config` is provided, then all fields in `.style.custom_config` will be used.

To use custom config only, the following `custom_config` params are required:
* `.style.custom_config.font`
* `.style.custom_config.text_color`
* `.style.custom_config.vertical_position`
* `.style.custom_config.horizontal_position`

font.description:
Font name from Google Fonts. Not all fonts support all languages or character sets. 
We recommend verifying language support and appearance directly on https://fonts.google.com before use.

font_size.description: Font size in pixels. If not provided, the font size is automatically calculated based on the video resolution.

highlighted_text_color.description: Color used to highlight the current spoken text

horizontal_position.description: Horizontal alignment of the text (e.g., left, center, right)

stroke_width.description: Width of the text stroke in pixels. If `stroke_color` is provided, but `stroke_width` is not, the `stroke_width` will be calculated automatically based on the font size.

text_color.description: Primary text color in hex format

vertical_position.description: Vertical alignment of the text (e.g., top, center, bottom)

template.description: Preset subtitle templates. Please visit https://magichour.ai/create/auto-subtitle-generator to see the style of the existing templates.

video.description: Attach the video from ChatGPT for this input.

download_url.description: Exact HTTPS download URL supplied for the native ChatGPT attachment, including its signed query.
download_url.title: Download Url

file_id.description: Native ChatGPT file identifier paired with download_url; not a local filesystem path.
file_id.title: File Id

file_name.description: Original attachment filename, when supplied by ChatGPT.
file_name.title: File Name

mime_type.description: Attachment MIME type, when supplied by ChatGPT.
mime_type.title: Mime Type

name: add_subtitles_to_video

credits_charged.description:
The amount of credits deducted from your account to generate the video. If the status is not 'complete', this value is an estimate and may be adjusted upon completion based on the actual FPS of the output video. 

If video generation fails, credits will be refunded, and this field will be updated to include the refund.

id.description: Unique ID of the video. Use it with the [Get video Project API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/video-projects/get-video-details) to fetch status and downloads.
